display.purpose: Home h1 in the left column (beside the illustration from md); Archivo 700 at 92 percent width, -0.03em; 2rem, 3.5rem at md, 4rem at lg; three lines EN, four FR.

door-heading.purpose: The audience word of each door band; 2rem, 2.75rem at md, 3.25rem at lg; Ink at rest, Signal when active.

headline.purpose: Inner-page h1 via PageHeader, 48rem column; 2.25rem then 3.5rem at md.

band-title.purpose: Closing band h2; 1.875rem then 2.5rem at md. Inner ClosingCTA one step down.

company-name.purpose: h3 of each company record with a status Pill beside it; 1.5rem then 1.875rem at md.

title.purpose: Section h2 via SectionHeader; 1.5rem then 1.75rem at md.

door-question.purpose: The one sentence beside the audience word, Archivo 400 at normal width; 1.125rem, 1.25rem at md, 1.5rem at lg.

lead.purpose: Steel paragraph under the home headline (0.875rem then 1.125rem at md, leading-snug, 36rem cap) or a page heading (1.125rem then 1.25rem at 1.625, 42rem cap).

body.purpose: Company descriptions, row definitions, FAQ answers, inputs.

ui.purpose: Buttons, nav links, arrow links, door calls, field labels, footer links; Archivo 500.

meta.purpose: Tabular small type: roles and years, attribution line, form counters; 0.75rem then 0.875rem at md.

label.purpose: Uppercase .label inside pills, footer group titles and the illustration's lane names; never above a heading.

flow-label.purpose: The step words under the illustration's nodes (md and up): 0.6875rem at 0.05em, uppercase, Steel at rest and Ink on the active lane.

shadows.name: none
shadows.purpose: No drop shadow anywhere. Surfaces are bounded by a 1px hairline or a Fog / Ink fill; the capsule header and cookie sheet float by translucency and backdrop-blur; the marks in the proof row sit directly on Paper.

shadows.name: focus-ring-input
shadows.purpose: The only box-shadow in the codebase: input and textarea focus ring beside a Signal border.

shadows.name: focus-ring-choice
shadows.purpose: has-[:focus-visible] ring on ChoiceGroup rows and FileDrop.

motion.name: ease-out
motion.value: cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1)
motion.purpose: Standard easing (--ease-out): entrance, door padding, node pop, door bar, FAQ height, form step slide, progress fill, success disc.

motion.name: ease-draw
motion.value: cubic-bezier(0.65, 0, 0.35, 1)
motion.purpose: Rail drawing in the illustration only.

motion.name: anim-rise
motion.value: opacity 0 to 1, translateY 14px to 0, 0.7s, backwards, --delay 0 / 120 / 200 / 260 / 420ms
motion.purpose: The one orchestrated entrance: headline, lead, attribution, illustration (md and up), door pair. Final state is the default state.

motion.name: flow-stub
motion.value: opacity 0 to 1, 0.4s ease-out, delay 420ms
motion.purpose: Hub stub, branch bar and arms of the illustration.

motion.name: flow-rail
motion.value: scaleX 0 to 1 from the origin, 1s ease-draw, delay 520ms + lane * 260ms (a scaleY phone variant exists but is not rendered)
motion.purpose: Each lane's rail draws itself.

motion.name: flow-node
motion.value: opacity 0 to 1, scale 0.4 to 1, 0.35s, delay 700ms + lane * 260ms + step * 200ms
motion.purpose: The four nodes of each lane pop in order.

motion.name: flow-label
motion.value: opacity 0 to 1, 0.4s ease-out, delay 780ms + lane * 260ms + step * 200ms
motion.purpose: Each step label follows its node by 80ms.

motion.name: flow-dot
motion.value: left 0 to calc(100% - 7px), 7s linear infinite, delay 1.8s + lane * 3.5s, opacity in over 6 percent and out over the last 6 percent
motion.purpose: A 7px dot travels each rail continuously; the illustration renders from md only.

motion.name: flow-active
motion.value: rail Ink, nodes and dot Signal, labels Ink, lane name Signal, 0.2s; other lane opacity 0.35, 0.25s
motion.purpose: The lane of the hovered or focused door lights up; the other fades.

motion.name: door-active
motion.value: padding-block 2.25rem at lg, heading colour Signal; padding 0.4s, colour 0.2s
motion.purpose: The hovered or focused door band grows and recolours.

motion.name: door-inactive
motion.value: padding-block 0.75rem at lg, opacity 0.45; padding 0.4s, opacity 0.25s
motion.purpose: The sibling band compresses and fades while one door is active.

motion.name: arrow-nudge
motion.value: translateX 4px on the door call, 2px on ArrowLink (diagonal when external), 200ms
motion.purpose: Only hover transform besides the door pair.

motion.name: mark-row
motion.value: scroll-linked (useScroll start end to end start): row x from the column free width (inner width minus row width, measured at mount and resize, md and up) to 0; per-mark drift Darix 24px to -16px, 6WAY 40px to -28px, MicePro 56px to -40px from md; below md no travel and drifts scaled by 0.35 (8 to -6, 14 to -10, 20 to -14px), same measurement; x 0 under reduced motion
motion.purpose: The row of three marks enters aligned right and leaves aligned left while the section passes through the viewport, each mark drifting at its own speed on top.

motion.name: door-bar
motion.value: translateY 100% to 0, 0.35s
motion.purpose: Mobile door bar visible from first paint, withdrawn while the door pair is on screen or the menu is open.

motion.name: cookie-shift
motion.value: bottom 0 to 4.5rem, 300ms
motion.purpose: Cookie sheet moves up while the mobile door bar is visible.

motion.name: step-pane
motion.value: in: opacity + translateX 28px * direction, 240ms; out: translateX -17px * direction, 140ms easeIn; reduced motion: 120ms / 80ms, no offset
motion.purpose: Direction-aware slide between form steps (inherited).

motion.name: step-rail
motion.value: scaleX 0 to 1 from left, 300ms, Signal fill
motion.purpose: Progress segment fill (inherited).

motion.name: success-check
motion.value: scale 0.6 to 1 with opacity, 350ms
motion.purpose: Signal disc on submission acknowledgement (inherited).

motion.name: faq-open
motion.value: block-size 0 to auto, 0.3s, via interpolate-size where supported; Plus icon rotates 45deg over 200ms
motion.purpose: details::details-content height animation.

motion.name: transition-fast
motion.value: 150ms
motion.purpose: Form control colour, border and ring changes.

motion.name: transition-ui
motion.value: 200ms
motion.purpose: Buttons, links, nav, door heading colour, lane colours, FAQ icon.

motion.name: reduced-motion
motion.value: anim-rise none; flow animations none and flow-dot hidden; .door transitions opacity and colour only; mark row static; door-bar none; details transition none; motion components fade without displacement
motion.purpose: prefers-reduced-motion block in globals.css and useReducedMotion in ProofStrip and forms.

motion.name: selection
motion.value: background #EDEFFE; color #000000
motion.purpose: ::selection.

motion.name: focus-ring
motion.value: outline 2px solid #2233E8; outline-offset 3px
motion.purpose: Global :focus-visible.

containers.name: narrow
containers.purpose: Form pages, PageHeader title cap, cookie sheet.

containers.name: lead
containers.purpose: Page leads, FAQ answers, SectionHeader text.

containers.name: home
containers.purpose: Home column, header capsule, footer, portfolio-style pages; the mark row clips viewport-wide through negative gutter margins.

fontAxes.headings: font-weight 700, font-stretch 92%, letter-spacing -0.03em (global h1 to h6 and .display)

logo.source: src/components/brand/Logo.tsx (LogoHorizontal, Mark), official kit paths inlined as SVG
logo.forbidden: recolour, rotate, outline, shadow, redraw, bitmap in header or footer

components.css: .ds-capsule { display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: space-between; gap: 16px; max-width: 72rem; padding: 8px 12px 8px 24px; border: 1px solid var(--f6-line, #E3E3DF); border-radius: 9999px; background: rgb(255 255 255 / 0.9); backdrop-filter: blur(12px); color: var(--f6-ink, #000000); font-family: Archivo, 'Helvetica Neue', Arial, sans-serif; } .ds-capsule-logo { font-weight: 700; font-stretch: 92%; letter-spacing: -0.03em; font-size: 1.5rem; } .ds-capsule-dot { color: var(--f6-signal, #2233E8); } .ds-capsule-nav { display: flex; gap: 28px; font-size: 0.875rem; font-weight: 500; } .ds-capsule-nav a { color: inherit; text-decoration: none; transition: color 200ms; } .ds-capsule-nav a:hover, .ds-capsule-active { color: var(--f6-signal, #2233E8); } .ds-capsule-right { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px; } .ds-capsule-lang { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 4px; height: 36px; padding: 0 10px; border: 0; background: none; font: inherit; font-size: 0.75rem; font-weight: 500; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; color: var(--f6-steel, #6E6E68); cursor: pointer; } .ds-capsule-lang-on { color: var(--f6-ink, #000000); } .ds-capsule-slash { color: var(--f6-line, #E3E3DF); } .ds-capsule-cta { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px; height: 36px; padding: 0 16px; border: 0; border-radius: 9999px; background: var(--f6-signal, #2233E8); color: #FFFFFF; font: inherit; font-size: 0.875rem; font-weight: 500; cursor: pointer; transition: background-color 200ms; } .ds-capsule-cta:hover { background: var(--f6-ink, #000000); } .ds-capsule a:focus-visible, .ds-capsule button:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--f6-signal, #2233E8); outline-offset: 3px; }

components.css: .ds-flow { display: grid; grid-template-columns: auto 1fr; align-items: center; gap: 32px; max-width: 560px; font-family: Archivo, 'Helvetica Neue', Arial, sans-serif; color: var(--f6-ink, #000000); } .ds-flow-hubwrap { position: relative; } .ds-flow-hub { display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; width: 72px; height: 72px; border-radius: 9999px; border: 1px solid rgb(110 110 104 / 0.6); background: #FFFFFF; font-weight: 700; font-stretch: 92%; letter-spacing: -0.03em; font-size: 1.375rem; } .ds-flow-hubdot { color: var(--f6-signal, #2233E8); } .ds-flow-stub { position: absolute; left: 100%; top: 50%; width: 32px; height: 1px; background: var(--f6-steel, #6E6E68); transform: translateY(-50%); animation: ds-fade 0.4s ease-out backwards; animation-delay: 420ms; } .ds-flow-lanes { position: relative; display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 56px; padding-left: 32px; } .ds-flow-branch { position: absolute; left: 0; top: 26px; bottom: 33px; width: 1px; background: var(--f6-steel, #6E6E68); animation: ds-fade 0.4s ease-out backwards; animation-delay: 420ms; } .ds-flow-arm { position: absolute; left: 0; width: 32px; height: 1px; background: var(--f6-steel, #6E6E68); animation: ds-fade 0.4s ease-out backwards; animation-delay: 420ms; } .ds-flow-arm-top { top: 26px; } .ds-flow-arm-bottom { bottom: 33px; } .ds-flow-lane { position: relative; padding-top: 20px; transition: opacity 0.25s ease; } .ds-flow-name { position: absolute; left: 0; top: 0; font-size: 0.6875rem; font-weight: 500; letter-spacing: 0.06em; text-transform: uppercase; color: var(--f6-steel, #6E6E68); white-space: nowrap; transition: color 0.2s ease; } .ds-flow-rail { position: absolute; left: 0; right: 0; top: 26px; height: 1px; background: var(--f6-steel, #6E6E68); transform-origin: left top; animation: ds-draw 1s cubic-bezier(0.65, 0, 0.35, 1) both; animation-delay: calc(520ms + var(--lane, 0) * 260ms); transition: background-color 0.2s ease; } .ds-flow-dot { position: absolute; top: 23px; width: 7px; height: 7px; border-radius: 9999px; background: var(--f6-ink, #000000); opacity: 0; animation: ds-travel 7s linear infinite; animation-delay: calc(1.8s + var(--lane, 0) * 3.5s); transition: background-color 0.2s ease; } .ds-flow-lane ol { position: relative; display: flex; justify-content: space-between; margin: 0; padding: 0; list-style: none; } .ds-flow-lane li { display: flex; flex-direction: column; align-items: center; gap: 10px; } .ds-flow-lane li:first-child { align-items: flex-start; } .ds-flow-lane li:last-child { align-items: flex-end; } .ds-flow-node { display: block; width: 13px; height: 13px; border-radius: 9999px; border: 2px solid #FFFFFF; background: var(--f6-ink, #000000); animation: ds-pop 0.35s cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1) backwards; animation-delay: calc(700ms + var(--lane, 0) * 260ms + var(--i, 0) * 200ms); transition: background-color 0.2s ease; } .ds-flow-label { font-size: 0.6875rem; font-weight: 500; letter-spacing: 0.05em; text-transform: uppercase; white-space: nowrap; color: var(--f6-steel, #6E6E68); animation: ds-fade 0.4s ease-out backwards; animation-delay: calc(780ms + var(--lane, 0) * 260ms + var(--i, 0) * 200ms); transition: color 0.2s ease; } .ds-flow:has(.ds-flow-lane:hover) .ds-flow-lane:not(:hover) { opacity: 0.35; } .ds-flow-lane:hover .ds-flow-rail { background: var(--f6-ink, #000000); } .ds-flow-lane:hover .ds-flow-node, .ds-flow-lane:hover .ds-flow-dot { background: var(--f6-signal, #2233E8); } .ds-flow-lane:hover .ds-flow-label { color: var(--f6-ink, #000000); } .ds-flow-lane:hover .ds-flow-name { color: var(--f6-signal, #2233E8); } @keyframes ds-fade { from { opacity: 0; } to { opacity: 1; } } @keyframes ds-draw { from { transform: scaleX(0); } to { transform: scaleX(1); } } @keyframes ds-pop { from { opacity: 0; transform: scale(0.4); } to { opacity: 1; transform: scale(1); } } @keyframes ds-travel { 0% { left: 0; opacity: 0; } 6% { opacity: 1; } 94% { opacity: 1; } 100% { left: calc(100% - 7px); opacity: 0; } } @media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) { .ds-flow-stub, .ds-flow-branch, .ds-flow-arm, .ds-flow-rail, .ds-flow-node, .ds-flow-label { animation: none; } .ds-flow-dot { display: none; } }

Is the online diagnostic an audit?

It gives a first direction based on the answers provided. An actual audit requires further analysis with the teams involved.

Do I need a finished specification to reach out?

No. A concrete problem, the tools involved, and a rough timeline are enough.

narrative.overview:
The site is a white page set in black with one blue signature, and its first screen is a structure rather than a picture: a headline and its Steel lead on the left, a code-drawn illustration on the right (from md; phones show the headline, lead and bands alone) in which From 6 is the hub two named lanes leave from, and under both, two short full-width bands facing each other under a hairline, one for company leaders and one for founders. Each band carries the audience word at display size, one question and one Signal link; the four real steps of each path live on the illustration's lanes. Nothing on the ground is tinted; everything structural is Ink on Paper, Steel hairlines, Line dividers and Steel sentences. Signal blue appears exactly where a reader can act, and once more on the door under the pointer and its lane.

One typeface family does every job. Archivo, loaded as a variable font with its width axis, is set heavy and narrow for headings (weight 700, width 92 percent, tracking -0.03em) and upright at normal width for everything read. Dates, years and counters are set in tabular numerals. There is no second face, no mono, no serif, and no kicker or eyebrow above a heading: the heading opens its block alone.

Surfaces are square and bounded by 1px lines, buttons, pills, the hub and the nodes are full circles, and nothing casts a shadow or carries a gradient. The header is a floating Paper capsule detached from the viewport edge. Proof is one sober row of the three company marks, drifting a few pixels on scroll, straight on Paper, then three records side by side. The home has one black band and it is the closing call, not the hero. Motion is one orchestrated entrance on the first screen that ends with the illustration drawing itself, the door and lane hover pair, a continuous dot on each lane, the scroll-linked mark row, 150 to 300ms colour transitions, and reduced-motion fallbacks for all of it. Secondary pages inherit the type, the header and the footer, and otherwise keep the recipes of the previous build: PageHeader, SectionHeader, RowList, ClosingCTA and the multi-step form kit.
keyCharacteristics: Eight neutrals and one accent, unchanged since the September kit: Signal is for the logo dot, links, buttons, the active door heading and its lane; Signal Soft is its form on black; Signal Wash is the selection and selected-row tint.

One family, two settings: Archivo 700 at 92 percent width and -0.03em for every heading and the .display utility; Archivo 400 and 500 at normal width for sentences, UI and labels; .tnum on every number that lines up.

Radius is 0 or a full circle. Bands, panels, inputs, records and the mobile menu are square; buttons, pills, radio marks, progress segments, the header capsule, the illustration's hub, nodes and travelling dot are round.
No shadows and no gradients. Depth is a 1px hairline, a Fog panel, or the single black band at the end of the home.

The first viewport is on Paper: intro left, illustration right from md, two short door bands under hairlines. The hover grammar is a pair: one band grows and turns Signal with its lane, the other band and lane fade.
Illustration is drawn in code from the palette's own materials: Steel hairlines, Ink nodes, uppercase labels and the F6 Mark; no generated imagery.
The header is a fixed Paper capsule at 90 percent with a blur, inset 12 to 16px from the edge, on every page; the mobile menu is a square Line-bordered panel beneath it.
Proof is real material, never redrawn: the Darix mark, the MicePro logo in monochrome and the 6WAY wordmark, laid on Paper in one row without panel, caption or label.
The logo is the kit's inline SVG in currentColor, lockup at 120px (mobile header), 136px (desktop header) and 140px (footer); the mark alone at 32px inside the illustration's hub (md and up).
Every visible string is an EN/FR pair through <T />; English is server-rendered.

rules.name: The Signal Rule
rules.body: Signal is reserved for the logo dot, links, buttons, the heading of the active door with its lane (name, nodes, dot) and the state of an action in progress (focus ring, selected choice and its wash, filled progress track, deposited file, success disc). It never fills a background, colours a resting heading, tints an icon or decorates a rule. On black it becomes Signal Soft. Emphasis anywhere else is weight, size, Steel or position.

rules.name: The One Band Rule
rules.body: The home carries exactly one black band and it is the closing call. The first viewport is on Paper. A black band swaps the neutrals, not the logic: Ink becomes Paper, Steel becomes Dark Steel, the primary button stays Signal (inverted) and hovers to Paper on Ink, the secondary is a Paper-at-30 percent outline (ghost).

rules.name: The Steel Body Rule
rules.body: Any sentence that supports a heading is Steel, and so is any line that is drawn rather than written. Ink is for headings, questions, terms, the current step title, the nodes, and the strings the reader must not miss.

rules.name: The One Family Rule
rules.body: Archivo is the only typeface. Hierarchy comes from the axes, never from a second face: 700 at 92 percent width and -0.03em for headings, 400 and 500 at normal width for everything else. No mono, no serif, no system display face.

rules.name: The Tabular Rule
rules.body: Every date, year, counter, duration and episode number carries .tnum so columns and rows of figures hold still.

rules.name: The Heading Alone Rule
rules.body: No kicker, eyebrow or uppercase label sits above a page, section or door heading. Uppercase lives inside the object it classifies: a Pill, a footer column, a lane of the illustration.

rules.name: The No Shadow Rule
rules.body: No surface, band, button, sheet, capsule, node or image carries a shadow. If a surface needs an edge, give it a 1px hairline; if it needs weight, give it a Fog or Ink fill.

rules.name: The Colour Hover Rule
rules.body: Hover changes a colour, not a position or a shadow. The only transforms on hover are the 2 to 4px nudge of an arrow icon and the door pair, where the active band gains padding and the inactive one loses it and fades to 45 percent while its lane fades to 35 percent.

rules.name: The Zero or Circle Rule
rules.body: A corner is square or the element is a pill. No 4, 8, 12 or 16px radius exists and none may be introduced.

rules.name: The Drawn in Code Rule
rules.body: An illustration is built from the palette's own materials, 1px Steel lines, Ink circles, uppercase labels and the official Mark, laid out with CSS. No generated imagery, no icon set, no third colour.

dos: Do build every surface from Ink, Paper, Fog, Line and Steel; reach for Dark Steel, Dark Fog and Dark Line only inside .hero-section, and keep that band to the closing call.

Do spend Signal only on the logo dot, text links, buttons, the active door heading with its lane, and in-progress form states; switch to Signal Soft for any link on black; hover a link to Ink and a primary button to Ink.
Do set every heading through the global h1 to h6 rule (Archivo 700, font-stretch: 92%, -0.03em) or the .display utility, and every sentence, control and label in Archivo at normal width.
Do put .tnum on every date, year, counter and duration.

Do open the home with the headline and lead beside the code-drawn illustration (from md), then the two short door bands on Paper; open inner pages with PageHeader and every section with SectionHeader; the heading carries alone.
Do draw any illustration from 1px Steel lines, Ink circles, uppercase labels and the official Mark, and let it share state with the element it explains.
Do show proof as the companies' real marks laid straight on Paper in one row, in monochrome where a logo would bring a third colour, named by the records beneath and by alt.
Do list things as RowList rows divided by Line.
Do make every button a pill: 44px medium, 48px large, 36px compact, Archivo 500, primary / outline / inverted / ghost, hover by colour change only.
Do keep the header as the Paper capsule at 90 percent with blur, inset from the edge, on every page.
Do keep controls square with a 1px Line border, and show focus as a Signal border plus a 15 percent Signal ring.
Do insert the logo as the inline SVG from Logo.tsx in currentColor, lockup at 120px or wider, mark at 20px or wider.

Do ease motion with cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1) (drawing with cubic-bezier(0.65, 0, 0.35, 1)), keep colour transitions between 150 and 300ms, make the final state the default state, and honour prefers-reduced-motion on anything that moves, loops or follows scroll.
Do ship every visible string as an EN/FR pair through <T en fr />, English first in the HTML, in real business French.
donts: Don't use Signal as a background, a resting heading colour, an icon tint or a decorative rule; the only blue fills are buttons, form states, the logo dot and the active lane's nodes and dot.
Don't introduce a gradient, a tinted grey, a second accent, an orb or a dark-mode theme; the black band is a local inversion, not a theme.
Don't put a black band or a card grid in the first viewport; the home hero is Paper with intro, illustration and two door bands under hairlines.
Don't add a drop shadow to anything, including the capsule, the cookie sheet, the door bar, the marks and the portrait; bound surfaces with a 1px hairline instead.
Don't use any radius other than 0 or 9999px: no rounded-sm, rounded-md, rounded-lg, rounded-xl, rounded-2xl.
Don't place an uppercase label, kicker or eyebrow above a page, section or door heading.
Don't load a second typeface; no Space Grotesk, no Inter, no mono, no serif, no system display face. Vary Archivo's weight and width instead.
Don't recolour, rotate, outline, shadow, redraw or rasterise the logo; never set the horizontal lockup below 120px.
Don't lift on hover: no translate, no scale, no shadow change on bands, buttons or rows; change padding (doors only), border or text colour instead.
Don't generate, illustrate or redraw proof or imagery; show real marks and logos, in monochrome where a logo would bring a third colour, and draw diagrams in code.
Don't put proof in a grey panel with a caption, nor pile up app screens; the mark row sits on Paper and the records name the companies.

Don't use em or en dashes in visible copy (comma, colon, parentheses; | in SEO titles), rhythmic word triplets separated by periods, emojis, hype, or any invented client, figure, testimonial, certification or criterion.
